name: After the Ambush

narrative.details:
We'd been hauling the barrels of powder back and forth in trips before this... business. Now we have to split up the work, Miran's taking the barrels and I'm watching over the other ones.

I don't feel safe letting Miran haul the rest of the shipment by himself. When he's ready to go, maybe you could escort him on his next trip?
narrative.offerRewardText:
Hello, Champion.

You'll be escorting me to the excavation site? That's good to hear... After Saean and his cronies, who knows what else the Dark Irons might have up their sleeves?

Anyways, let me just make some final checks. Talk to me again when you're ready to go.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests at level 15, 2,520 XP in all.

quests.name: Excavation Progress Report
quests.objectiveText: Bring Ironband's Progress Report to Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar.

quests.name: Report to Ironforge
quests.objectiveText: Take Ironband's Progress Report to Prospector Stormpike.

quests.name: Powder to Ironband
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar.

quests.name: Protecting the Shipment
quests.objectiveText: Ensure Miran and the shipment arrive at the excavation site, then inform Prospector Ironband.
